dag_infos.description: Taiwan historical unemployment rates by age, gender and education dimensions from the DGBAS open-data XML. Rates are not converted to counts or population-scaled for ages 18-35.

data_infos.name_cn: 失業率（按年齡組別、性別及教育程度）
data_infos.source_type: 行政院主計總處資料開放 XML
data_infos.dataset_description: 台灣地區人力資源調查失業率，含年、年月、性別、年齡組別及教育程度別欄位。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the live mp0101a07.xml resource with a browser User-Agent, resolve period values as YYYY or YYYYMM/YYYYMmm, parse age labels into integer intervals, emit the source's age/gender/education rates without any 18-35 conversion, and reconcile every numeric selected source cell to an output row. The source is nationwide, so area_code=TW and area_level=country rather than the New Taipei code.
